_readme: Support contacts shown on the support/crisis screen. Every entry in `resources` needs verified_at (YYYY-MM-DD): the date a teammate opened the source link or sent a WhatsApp message and confirmed the contact still works. npm run db:seed-safety refuses to load entries without it. Exactly one entry may have is_primary_crisis: true (shown first). type: crisis | counselling | self_help. tags: theme codes (sleep, workload, exams, isolation, relationships, finance, health, motivation). Crisis contacts return `phone` as a tel: link before `url`, so WhatsApp-only lines must use a wa.me link in `url` and phone: null. faculty: optional faculty code (counselling only, see FacultyCode in shared/contract.ts), null = all UGM students. `verify_notes` is for the verifier and is not loaded. Research gathered 2026-10-17.
